test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is not a characteristic of 'solid'?

options.text: A solid has a fixed volume.
Solids can break when subjected to force.
It is difficult to change the shape of solids, so they are hard

solution:
The correct answer is __**Solids can be compressed easily**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Solid is a** form of matter **that has **structural rigidity and a firm shape** which cannot be changed easily.

 
 
• It has a** fixed shape and volume**.
 
• The **intermolecular force of attraction is strong** as molecules of particles are closely attached.
 
• There is** less Intermolecular space** between particles.
 
• They are **not easily compressible**.
 
• It is difficult to change the shape of solids, so they are hard.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
